messages:
Mason: Heads-up — we just got a report from a cloud partner: after their upstream driver update + CUDA 12.2.1 images, quantized kernels are producing wrong outputs on A100S. This looks like a regress-in-kernel, not model weights. Link to partner bug: https://git.redwood/issue/PR-4721. Can we align on an immediate pin + hotfix communication plan?
Leah: Which partner images are affected (marketplace vs. dedicated/private installs)?
Mason: Primarily marketplace AMIs and partner-managed containers that pulled latest nvidia-driver. A few dedicated private deploys also pulled the driver via our recommended base image.
Raj: Quick triage notes: reproduces with seq_len=2048 fp16 + 4-bit quant path. Suspect CUDA/cuBLAS kernel selection change. Repro script: `scripts/repro/quant-kernel-a100.sh`.
Ana: We should stop market image rollout and publish an advisory. Can we propose a pinned combo to recommend to partners while we work a hotpatch?
Vicky: +1 to advisory. Also need an internal test matrix (driver, CUDA, hw) so partners know which combos are safe. I can spin up the matrix in infra. ETA 2 hours.
Raj: Short-term safe pin: NVIDIA driver 525.89.02 + CUDA 12.1. That combo passes our heavy quant + KF tests. Example container ENV snippet partners can use: ```
FROM redwood/runtime:prod-2026-03
ENV NVIDIA_DRIVER_VERSION=525.89.02
ENV CUDA_VERSION=12.1
```
Leah: Can marketing/partner comms get a plain-language advisory we can send to partners and marketplace owners? Outline: impact, who is affected, mitigation (pin), timeline for fix, contact for escalation.
Mason: Draft advisory: "If you've updated to the latest NVIDIA driver/CUDA 12.2.x and see degraded output or incorrect token probabilities on quantized models, pin to driver 525.89.02 + CUDA 12.1 and contact partnerships@redwood.com. We're coordinating a hotfix and validation sweep." Thoughts?
Raj: Add: run `python -m redwood.tests.quant_check --model gpt-small --seq 2048` as validation after pin.
Ana: Operational plan: 1) Stop marketplace auto-promotion (Leah) 2) Publish advisory & partner email (Leah + Vicky) 3) Infra validate pinned combo across regions (Vicky) 4) Engineering hotfix attempt for kernel selector fallback + QA (Raj + Mason) 5) Canary rollout of patched runtime to 5% (deploy-bot) 6) Full rollout if green.
Leah: I can publish advisory draft in 30m and send to partner POCs. Include a short FAQ.
Vicky: Infra job queued — matrix will run on eu-west and us-west A100 fleets, will post results to the ticket.
Raj: If kernel fix is nontrivial, fallback plan is to pin in our runtime and force the safe kernel path while driver fix is pending. That avoids waiting on OEM patch.
Mason: Agreed. We should also prepare marketplace image rollback instructions for partners who upgraded. Add a script `tools/rollback-driver.sh` to docs.
Deploy-bot: Canary deployment scheduled: redwood/runtime:canary-2026-03 -> 5% at 2026-03-21T15:30Z (triggered by Raj).
Leah: I'll coordinate partner comms. Tagging @channel for visibility in case other partner teams are impacted. :loudspeaker: :warning:
Mason: Thanks everyone. Please update ticket PR-4721 with test outputs and any partner replies. We'll reconvene after infra matrix completes (~2h).
